title: ChatGPT might not be using the model you think — and it’s also hiding others in settings | TechRadar
summary: ChatGPT now presents a simplified model selection interface with three modes (Instant, Thinking, Pro) that may not guarantee consistent model usage, potentially leading to varied user experiences.
sentiment_reason: The article discusses concerns about unpredictability and the potential for slower responses due to model switching, which could lead to negative user experiences.
